subject: Initial access planning and API token ramp for HealthPrime
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia@healthprime.com>, ops@healthprime.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Initial access planning and API token ramp for HealthPrime

Hi Alicia / HealthPrime ops team,

Thanks again for signing — excited to get you into a dev tenant and seed API keys. Quick recap and asks so we can schedule the technical handoff next week: 

- Desired tenant/project name(s): please confirm the exact short name we should create (we typically use company-shortenv, e.g. healthprime-prod / healthprime-staging).
- Admin list (full name + email) who should receive owner-level invites and KMS access.
- Hosting region preference (default is us-west-2).
- Any PKI/KMS restrictions or IP allowlists we should pre-configure.

Action items I'm proposing:
1) Redwood creates a staging tenant and seeds two API tokens (service and deploy) — tokens will be delivered to your SRE mailbox via secure DocuSign link.
2) Monica (CS) will run the implementation checklist with your engineers in a 60-min session.
3) Ben (Solutions) will confirm the quota and throughput targets for the initial canary.

Attached is a short scoping sheet (healthprime-scoping-sheet.xlsx) — please fill the admin list and region preference and return by EOD Thu so we can provision on Fri.

If Thu is tight, propose Fri 10:00am PT for a 45–60m technical walk.

Thanks,

Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

---
Attachment: healthprime-scoping-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Alicia Romero <alicia@healthprime.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@healthprime.com, security@healthprime.com
Date: Wed, 15 Feb 2028 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial access planning and API token ramp for HealthPrime

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear plan. We're ready to move forward. A few answers and notes below: 

- Tenant/project names: healthprime-staging and healthprime-prod. Please create staging first.
- Admins: Alicia Romero <alicia@healthprime.com>, Daniel Park <daniel.park@healthprime.com> (SRE).
- Region: prefer us-west-2.
- KMS: we need tokens encrypted with our AWS KMS key (alias/healthprime/kms).
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a CIDR block after provisioning (security@healthprime.com will follow up).

One security note: our Security team requires a short response to the questionnaire item about data residency and key custody before we accept production tokens. I copied security@ so they have the thread.

Can we do the technical handoff on Fri 10am PT — that works for our engineers.

Thanks,
Alicia
Head of Ops, HealthPrime
alicia@healthprime.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia@healthprime.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Feb 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial access planning and API token ramp for HealthPrime

Hi team — prepping the implementation session agenda and checklist (attached). Key operational notes for Fri's handoff: 

Agenda (45m):
- 0-5m: introductions and success criteria for canary
- 5-20m: tenant/project layout & roles (we'll demo the admin console and invite flow)
- 20-35m: API token usage + safe key rotation pattern (we'll show ephemeral token exchange and the DocuSign delivery flow)
- 35-45m: Q&A + next steps (canary date, monitoring links)

Operational housekeeping:
- We'll create healthprime-staging by Fri morning and invite Alicia and Daniel as org-admins.
- API tokens: we will seed two tokens (service-token, deploy-token) and deliver via DocuSign link to daniel.park@healthprime.com. After delivery, we recommend rotating the service-token and storing the new value in your KMS.
- For KMS integration: please share the grant ARN we should use for envelope encryption, or confirm that Redwood can put tokens into your S3+KMS bucket (we will not persist plaintext tokens in our control plane).

Attachments: implementation-checklist.pdf (PDF) — contains the step-by-step seeding and post-provision validation tests we will run during the session.

Linking the sprint plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-healthprime-onboarding (I added a short doc titled "canary-runbook.md").

See you Fri 10:00am PT — dial-in will be the standard Zoom link in the calendar invite.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Engineer
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: implementation-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Romero <alicia@healthprime.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Feb 2028 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial access planning and API token ramp for HealthPrime

Perfect — thanks all. Confirming a couple quick items before the handoff: 

- Canary target: 10k tokens/min sustained for the first 24h (we'll provision for burst to 30k). Please flag if that is too high.
- Quota invoice: I'll put the initial reserved capacity estimate into HubSpot for approvals (link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HP-Deal-HP-2028-014).

Alicia/Daniel — we'll see you Fri 10am PT for the technical handoff. If anything changes, drop a note here and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
